image_prompt.text: a massive pine forest spanning a wide area, thick-trunked trees set widely apart, trunks bare for the first 10-15 studs so players walk freely underneath, full foliage canopies high overhead
a large lake at the centre of the forest, shallow enough at the edges to wade into before the bed drops away
rocks, fallen logs and bushes scattered across the forest floor, with open grassy clearings breaking up the trees
earthy ground underfoot with patches of grass across it

notes: Genre taken from the prompt's own words, 'this is a survival game forest'. Everything else it says is environment: no threat, no round, no gathering, no roles, so no Survival option fired and layout_placement is empty.

Shape is a loose fit. `arena-contained` was taken as the bounded natural expanse the game plays out in, and it is the P0 shape. `warren-looping` is chase architecture and `world-biomes` wants regions whose threat scales with distance, which this single continuous single-biome forest does not have; rejecting it also avoids its P4.
CHECK comes from the lake. It is a flat surface with shallow shelving edges and no self-occlusion, so it should clear the volumetric check rather than block the build.
The canopies sit high above walkable ground purely as headroom, not as a second layer of play surface, so no P2 was added.

would have asked: whether the forest wants a survival mode built into it — a scripted hazard with high ground and collapsing cover (Disaster Survival), or gatherable wood and stone with buildable ground (Resource Survival). No preset was offered as taken, because every preset here supplies a threat or a gathering loop the prompt never mentions, and Resource Survival would also drag `world-biomes` and its P4 in with it.
would have asked: confirming this is one continuous forest rather than several linked regions, since that is what kept the route off P4.
would have asked: anything else you want in the space? Wildlife, a shoreline camp, or relief in the ground would each land on an existing option, and none of them are in the prompt as written.
